Ceremony of Innocence

2017
Water, steel, oil drum, video projection

A block of ice hangs over a steel oil drum. Projected onto the ice and the wall behind it, the international symbol for extinction appears alongside a sunken astronomical symbol for Earth. Each day of the week-long exhibition the block melted into the drum and was replaced with a new one, a ceremony repeated until the show closed. The title comes from Yeats’s “The Second Coming”: “The ceremony of innocence is drowned.” Made with Mark Read and shown in “From Outrage to Action” at the Gallatin Galleries, New York University.
